rebuttal_response: P03-QA-001 remains a blocker. The authorization conflict explains why P03 cannot repair those files, but it does not convert failed completion gates into PASS. The prompt explicitly requires all tests to pass, requires Test 7 failures to be confined to exact P04-owned handoffs, and directs execution to stop on an unowned test failure. The lawful outcome is escalation as a blocked checkpoint, not labeling Test 7 “PASS, with exceptions.” Reverting may be undesirable, but that does not establish completion. Also, the six cases are four predecessor-checkpoint tests, one P03-caused baseline-tool break, and one frozen-harness failure—not five predecessor self-tests plus one frozen failure as v2 states.

findings.title: Regression test is labeled PASS despite failures outside its permitted boundary
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires a PASS/FAIL conclusion supported by evidence; criterion 4 requires stop conditions and successor authority boundaries to be honored; criterion 5 requires relevant failures to be classified honestly.
findings.trigger: The full t1 suite exits 1 with six new failures outside the exact P04 resource/root handoff.
findings.consequence: The prompt’s `require_all_tests_pass` gate and Test 7 expected result are unsatisfied, so P03 is blocked and cannot report Test 7 as PASS.
findings.evidence: Section 3 labels Test 7 “PASS, with a scoped ... exception set,” while recording exit=1 and six non-P04 failures. Four are predecessor-checkpoint assertions, one is `test_inventory.py` exposing the P03-caused broken import in `tools/refactor_repo/baseline.py:137`, and one is the frozen Plan 26 harness. The prompt requires all non-root/resource tests to pass, exact P04 ownership for failures, and immediate stopping on an unowned test failure.

findings.title: Independent QA test remains incomplete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 says an unavailable or inconclusive check is not PASS; criterion 7 requires a witnessed and verified `QA_PASSED` result before completion.
findings.trigger: The exact v2 artifact has not yet received and verified an independent passing verdict.
findings.consequence: Test 8 and the overall checkpoint completion gate remain open.
findings.evidence: Test 8 says “In progress,” and Section 7 describes this as the round-2 submission rather than recording a witnessed `QA_PASSED` verification for `P03_checkpoint_report.v2.md`.

findings.title: Several prompt tests still lack exact reproducible commands or statuses
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires every prompt TEST’s exact command or inspection procedure, exit status, material output, and supported conclusion.
findings.trigger: A reviewer attempts to reproduce Tests 1, 2, or 5 solely from the checkpoint evidence.
findings.consequence: The recorded PASS conclusions cannot be reproduced exactly from the report.
findings.evidence: Test 1 describes a manual cross-reference but does not specify the complete inspection procedure or a status. Test 2 gives `wc -l` without its input redirection and cites the later apply pass instead of preserving the required pre-move dry-run reconciliation. Test 5 replaces executable portions with `...`, `<repo root>`, and abbreviated Python snippets, so the origin and forbidden-import checks are not exact commands.

findings.title: The final path ledger and deliverable integrity record remain incomplete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2 requires every changed, created, moved, and deleted path; criterion 6 requires post-change status and a reviewable diff or immutable digest for every deliverable.
findings.trigger: Untracked directory entries and checkpoint artifacts are audited as individual deliverables.
findings.consequence: The evidence cannot establish the exact content and path of every checkpoint, exception, execution, and moved-source deliverable.
findings.evidence: `git_status_porcelain_final.txt` collapses untracked trees into directory entries such as `?? checkpoints/P03/`, `?? exceptions/`, `?? execution/P03/`, and `?? src/curriculum_factory/langgraph_factory/`, rather than listing every contained path. `git_diff_stat_final.txt` excludes untracked file contents. Digest manifests cover `src/curriculum_factory` and `tests/runtime`, but not every exception, execution-log, checkpoint, QA, or other evidence deliverable.

observations: P03-QA-003 is resolved: v2 identifies the prompt, specification version, baseline commit, starting state, and exact artifact version.
The report now openly calls the six non-resource failures blockers and avoids claiming overall checkpoint completion; the remaining defect is its contradictory PASS label for Test 7.
reasoning: The round history matches my prior verdict. I accepted the identity-field repair, but the authorization rebuttal does not override the prompt’s explicit all-tests-pass and exact-P04-boundary requirements. Literal evidence also shows that reproducibility and complete per-deliverable review records remain incomplete.
